feeds.title: Greek Orthodox Religious Tourism
feeds.description: The religious heritage of Greece attracts visitors from all over the world who visit churches and monasteries throughout the country that are often located in areas of exceptional scenery. The purpose of this page is to record, highlight and display religious and pilgrimage destinations in our country.

feeds.title: Saint John the Baptist - Greek Orthodox Church
feeds.description: The mission of St. John the Baptist Greek Orthodox Church in Euless TX is to keep, practice, and proclaim the Orthodox Christian Faith.

feeds.title: Πνεύματος κοινωνία
feeds.description: Spirit Society is a Greek language blog that discusses topics related to the Eastern Orthodox Church. The blog was created by Jimmy Rodis, who is a Greek Orthodox priest. The blog covers a wide range of topics, including theology, spirituality, and current events. The blog is well-written and informative, and it provides a valuable resource for Orthodox Christians.

feeds.title: Orthodox Christian Initiative for Africa
feeds.description: We are Orthodox Christian Greeks.Because we are Orthodox Christians, we love our country, our people and all the peoples of the earth; this of course includes our African brothers and sisters.

feeds.title: Saint Thomas Greek Orthodox Church
feeds.description: Our mission is to continually build a church that is relevant, constantly recognizes and meets people's needs, pursues the teaching of God's Word and always provides an atmosphere for positive relationships to grow and develop.

feeds.title: Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Cathedral » Church News
feeds.description: Holy Trinity Greek Orthodox Cathedral, situated at the threshold of Toledo's central business district, serves the spiritual needs of 800 Christian souls in Northwest Ohio and Southeast Michigan.

feeds.title: Orthodox Way of Life
feeds.description: Information on how to live the Orthodox way of life from the Saint George Greek Orthodox Cathedral. This blog offers Articles and information about how to live an Orthodox Christian life. This includes prayer, fasting, repentance, holy communion and the other sacraments of the Eastern Orthodox Church.

feeds.title: Greek Orthodox Church of Bordeaux
feeds.description: This blog is dedicated to the parish activities of the Greek Orthodox Church of Bordeaux and its community located throughout the Gironde. You will find all the news and information of the Church of 'Presentation of the Blessed Virgin at the temple', the Hellenic cult association of Bordeaux, as well as cultural events that revolve around them.

feeds.description: St Vasilios Church Brunswick is a parish of the Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of Australia. The purpose of this site is to keep you informed both of church services and events, and of the teachings of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of America
feeds.description: The Greek Orthodox Archdiocese of America, headquartered in the City of New York, is an Eparchy of the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople. The mission of the Archdiocese is to proclaim the Gospel of Christ, to teach and spread the Orthodox Christian Faith, to energize, cultivate, and guide the life of the Church according to the Orthodox Christian Faith and Tradition.
